name: schedule-refused
description: The callee genuinely cannot name a time. The caller does not push a third time and does not leave a number. A human decides what happens next.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good morning. I'm an automated assistant calling on behalf of Amina Otieno, with her permission.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Do you need the referral letter before the appointment?

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: The doctor handles referrals himself and he's on leave. We'll get back to you.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm not able to take a call back. When should I call you instead?

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Honestly I can't say. There's no way of knowing when he'll pick up his messages.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That's understood. Thank you for your help.
